'''Letaki''' was a planet in the [[Letaki system/Legends|Letaki system]] of [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the homeworld of [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], a member of the [[Letaki|eponymous]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
